subject: The autumn revenue being brought in to a tehsil office in a north Indian district. The tahsildar sits cross-legged on a low dais with a long cloth-bound ledger open before him and a brass inkpot at his side. Cultivators in white dhotis queue with sacks of grain and small cloth bundles of coin; one bows, one argues, one waits with his son. A clerk squats beside the dais writing. Behind, the low whitewashed tehsil building with a deep arcaded verandah, a peepul tree, and a pair of bullocks with a cart. Cold-weather light, an early winter morning.
